scope: West Kilbride and Maryland: a conditional Ayrshire family
publication_summary: Selected John-3375 as uncertain father of John-3161 through possible identity with the 1679 Kilwinning child, and John-3161 as uncertain father of Rev. Patrick-635 through the possible 1700 West Kilbride childhood. The inherited 1680 minister birth conflicts if literal; the model explicitly treats it as an unsupported estimate, preserves the fields, and retains alternative identities. Two dependent childhood hypotheses, no new mothers or merges. Largest working family through 1850: 980 to 989 retained profiles; components 435 to 433; unattached fathers with two or more children 53 to 52. Confident metrics and population unchanged. Catalogue parent columns and missing-parent filters now use the same current assessed relationships as the dossiers; this publication repair is not counted as a new genealogical connection.
